d:
Marasu Toofan dene vala hai dastak... UP aur Bihar men red alart, bachke rahna hai ! bangal ki khari se utha bhishan chakravati tuphan 'murasu' (Murasu) aandhr pradesh ke tatiy ilakon men bhari tabahi macha raha hai. mangalvar tarke chakravat murasu ka laindphol ongol ke pas huaa, jahan 110 se 120 kilomitar prati ghante ki raphtar se chali tez havaon aur musladhar barish ne janjivan ast-vyast kar diya. tabahi machane ke bad murasu
Chhattisgarh ki taraph barh raha hai jisse yupi-bihar par khatra mandrane laga hai.
